title: PCR (Toehold) Fragment Protocol for a 25ul Reaction
author: Janet Standeven
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.786hrze
materials: Annealing temperatures vary depending on DNA

steps.title: Prepare PCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Pipette all reaction agents into a PCR tube for a 25ul reaction.

steps.title: Configure Thermal Cycler
steps.instruction: Place the PCR tube in the thermal cycler and configure the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Set the annealing temperature to 55 degrees Celsius.
Set the elongation time to 30 seconds (or 1 min/2kb for Q5 High Fidelity, though this may vary).
